reviews.text: I've been bringing my dog ​​here since he was a puppy and have always found the staff attentive and loving. My dog ​​always loves coming here.

I entrusted my Labrador to Marianna for a week and I couldn't have made a better choice. Marianna is a wonderful woman, extremely sweet, caring, and with a true passion for animals. Throughout the seven days, she kept me updated, sending me photos and videos of my dog ​​playing and having a blast. Seeing him so calm and happy allowed me to enjoy the week with complete peace of mind. House of Dogs is an absolute guarantee; I would entrust him to her again with my eyes closed!

Oliver is my Jack Russell, incredibly affectionate with those he knows, but wary of the rest of the world. Thanks to the House of Dogs team, he's managed to break down all his resistance and barriers. With professionalism and love, they're helping him make a wonderful transition. There, he's found a second family and a true "sweet home." Thank you so much ❤️
Cuddle photos at House ❤️

I was looking for a place where I could leave Pepito in the company of other dogs, free to socialize and have fun in my absence, whenever needed. Here I found professionalism, a welcoming atmosphere, and the utmost willingness to take care of him. Pepito always comes back willingly, and I have the peace of mind to leave him, knowing he'll be happy the whole time, well cared for and pampered. Highly recommended.

My furry friend loves going there. He doesn't even say hello when he arrives, so much is his joy in playing with the other dogs.
The atmosphere is family-friendly, and they treat the animal really well.

I wholeheartedly recommend House of Dogs. They sent us tons of photos and videos throughout the day, so we always knew exactly how our girl was doing and could see she was genuinely having a great time. The environment is clearly a loving one, the staff are warm with the dogs and professional with the owners, and communication was excellent from the first message to pickup. She comes home happy every time. Thank you for taking such good care of her!
My dachshund had a blast! The staff is super helpful and friendly; they let the dogs roam free and take them out often. Highly recommended.

We left our dog Harius at the boarding facility for 10 days and couldn't have made a better choice. From the very first moment, we felt at ease thanks to the professionalism, helpfulness, and kindness of the entire staff.
Harius had a wonderful time; he was looked after with care, pampered, and treated with so much affection. The trainers are truly friendly, knowledgeable, and animal lovers, traits that are immediately evident in the way they care for their guests.
Throughout his stay, we felt confident he was in excellent hands, and upon his return, we found him calm, happy, and in perfect health.
A huge thank you to everyone for making Harius feel at home. We recommend this facility to anyone looking for a safe and welcoming place for their four-legged friend!
🐾❤️ Harius and his family.

We'd had an unpleasant experience with dog boarding, then a friend recommended this place. We left our little prince Ulisse at House of Dogs for a week without hesitation because it immediately seemed safe, secure, and clean. The staff was very helpful and knowledgeable; during our stay, we received updates and photos that reassured us, and we were able to enjoy our vacation with complete peace of mind.
When we checked out, Ulisse was calm and smelled wonderful!
Thanks to Marianna and his wonderful father!

We entrusted our dog to House of Dogs and the experience was truly excellent. From our first meeting, we found the staff professional, helpful, and attentive to each dog's needs. The facilities are well-maintained, clean, and designed for their well-being, and the photo and video updates throughout the day always made us feel at ease.

Our dog Thommy had a wonderful time, returning home calm and happy every time. It's clear how much love, expertise, and passion they dedicate to their four-legged guests.

We recommend House of Dogs to anyone looking for a reliable daycare or boarding facility where their dog can truly feel at home. A heartfelt thank you to all the staff! 🐾

We couldn't be happier to have chosen this daycare for Cesare. Every morning, as soon as he hears the phrase "Shall we go to daycare?", he lights up and becomes instantly elated. He's so excited to go that he even recognizes the car when they pick him up and runs enthusiastically without hesitation.
For us, this is the greatest confirmation: Cesare feels loved, safe, and having a blast. The entire staff is truly wonderful, attentive, professional, and, above all, in love with dogs.
Cesare adores them, and we feel at ease knowing he spends his days in a peaceful, stimulating, and loving environment.
Very welcoming and well-organized place. The staff was kind and helpful. They met my puppy's needs. It's hard to find such kind and professional people. I was very happy. We'll definitely be back.

I highly recommend it!
I've brought my dog ​​both for the day and overnight, and she's always come home happy and calm! Marianna is also a very sweet and helpful person.

From our first meeting, we knew it would be the perfect place to leave our little Fubá for two weeks.
The environment is super clean and well-kept, and it's also surrounded by parks where dogs can have lots of fun!
Giulia and Mari kept me updated by sending me photos of my little one, so I also had peace of mind.
I highly recommend their services 🐶🫶🏻

Positive experience. Friendly and helpful staff, clean and organized facility, updates and photos throughout the stay that make you feel at ease. I found Mia calm and in excellent shape, and she settled in quite quickly. Highly recommended!
Excellent property, clean and comfortable. I really appreciated the attention and care my Jolie received during her nine-day stay. I highly recommend it!
Wonderful place for my dog ​​ARIA

We left our little Golden Retriever for three days, and she came back very happy and serene.
The trainers sent us photos and videos, and our dog will definitely return.
The team at House of Dogs is competent, loving, and empathetic. They do everything to make the dog feel comfortable. I would gladly bring my dog ​​back to House of Dogs! Thank you so much!

I chose House of Dog for day and night boarding for my one-and-a-half-year-old poodle!
I'm really happy and couldn't have made a better choice! The first visit was reassuring, the environment was welcoming and spotlessly clean!
The dog then stayed for two nights, and the owner sent me numerous photos where I always saw my pup at ease! I picked her up happy and smelling great! I can honestly say they've become my go-to!
Kudos to the facility: the dogs have a blast and are perfectly cared for! Highly recommended to anyone looking to take their pooch for a wonderful day!

Excellent experience with Marianna! She cared for my pinscher Kyro for 3 days, regularly sending me photos and videos.
Kyro remained very calm, and I found him in great shape.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for professionalism and love for animals.

I left my small dog at the boarding facility for 11 days. The staff was always very attentive, professional, and helpful, treating all guests with care and affection, ensuring complete safety. The puppy was very happy! Highly recommended!
I'm very happy with how they took care of him and how he was. They sent me videos and photos so I could see how he was. I'll definitely be back.
Like at home ❤️
Marianna is very good with my Cotoletta who is safe and having fun at House of Dogs ❤️
This is the second time I've left my dog ​​with them for short trips. Marianna is always available for last-minute requests and changes and is always affectionate with dogs!

I left my dachshund at the boarding kennel for eight days and was more than happy. From the first time I went to see the place, I felt right at home.
Marianna is fantastic, kind, and super helpful; she sent me photos and videos of Giotto every day. Highly recommended, I will use House of Dogs whenever I need it!!! ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

I had a wonderful time at House of Dogs!
The staff is super friendly. I've left my 8-month-old Chihuahua Carlo there several times already, and I've felt incredibly at ease thanks to the constant updates and knowing that the dogs are treated like a 5-star hotel!
I recommend it to anyone who needs to leave their dog for a few days and have peace of mind!
The staff is always present, so your dogs are always supervised!
5 stars!

I left my dog ​​Bibi (a dachshund) with them for 10 days and couldn't have made a better choice! They kept me updated every day with photos and videos, always making me feel at ease. When I returned, I found Bibi happy, calm, and even bathed with gentle products perfect for her. You can see the love and professionalism in everything they do. Highly recommended!

Highly recommended! The staff is kind, qualified, and helpful.
They truly care about making your stay a positive experience for you and your furry friend. I was kept updated from the first day (pickup at home, departure to the kennel), the following days, and until the last (home delivery) with photos and videos of my Avena.
At the end, they even gave us a tote bag with small gifts for Avena (cookies and a toy).

This has been the best experience I've ever had with a kennel, and it's also the first time they've delivered my little one happy and calm.

I will definitely use them again in the future. 😌

December 2024, review a little late, but I wanted to leave it.

I had to leave my one-year-old dog at the last minute, for his first time, in a boarding kennel for 10 days. I found House of Dogs online, but I already knew on the phone that the person I was talking to, Mari, had the calm and warmth that was right for my dog.
Well, practically without a placement, my Maltese was great, pampered, cleaned, cared for, but above all, I think he also had a great time with the other dogs, since when I returned, after the necessary holidays, he wanted to go back to his friends😂.
For my part, Mari sent me videos and photos at least twice a day. I forgot... She made sure he was freshly groomed... A legend!!!
I recommend, in fact I highly recommend, House of Dogs to everyone, and I thank Mari again from the bottom of my heart.
I absolutely recommend it! Mary and her family are so sweet. I'm so happy I entrusted them with my little Gerry for all those days! How wonderful to have found you!
I absolutely recommend them! Mary and her family are so sweet. I'm so happy I entrusted them with my little Gerry for all those days... 😍 …
Beautiful facility, newly furnished and clean. Marianna takes care of her four-legged guests with professionalism and affection. I feel very comfortable leaving our little Milly with her <3

I left my puppy Giulio at House of Dogs for several days and was very satisfied with the experience. Giulio had a great time and had a blast. Marianna, who cared for him, is truly kind, helpful, and caring.
I highly recommend House of Dogs to
anyone looking for a safe and welcoming place to leave their four-legged friend.
See you next time!

Super nice and helpful girls! Highly recommended. My 3-year-old golden retriever, Glorietta, had never been left with anyone for so many days in a row, and it made me a little anxious, but with them I felt really at ease. We'll definitely bring her back to them when the need arises. Thanks again!!!

I left my little Oliver for a weekend at House of Dog, and I was thrilled with the treatment my little one
received. Marianna is an animal lover, and she took exceptional care of my puppy. He was treated like a prince and spoiled with cuddles. I highly recommend it.
Highly recommended!!!! Marianna is fantastic, a truly loving home for our puppies.
An extremely positive experience, you can really see that there is an incredible love for animals!

House of Dogs is the perfect place to leave our four-legged friends. I needed to leave my two furry friends for about six days and needed someone to care for them as I do. I wasn't disappointed because Marianna was super kind in reassuring me and keeping me updated. She has a pure love for our four-legged friends and is truly kind to us owners.
I would recommend this place to all dog owners because here you'll find professionalism, expertise (something not to be underestimated), cleanliness, attention, love, and plenty of fun for your pooches.
Thank you, House of Dogs, and see you soon!

I've been taking Cecio as needed for a month now, and I have to say that from day one, I've always felt comfortable and, above all, I'm comfortable leaving him even though he's a 7-month-old puppy. Professionalism and, above all, patience in our case 😅 …

House of Dogs is simply fantastic! Our two dogs, Sarki and Dylan, were treated with incredible care and affection. From the moment we arrived, we noticed the professionalism and love the entire staff shows towards the animals. It's clear …
We entrusted our bulldog to a very helpful and professional person for 10 days. Thank you from us and our little Otto.
